name: How long does stucco re-flashing typically take?
description: Stucco re-flashing can take one to several days, depending on the number of areas, extent of damage, and weather conditions.

mainEntity.name: How long does stucco re-flashing typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of stucco re-flashing varies depending on the project's scope and the number of areas requiring repair. Re-flashing a single window or door opening might take a day or two, assuming no significant underlying damage. For multiple openings or extensive damage requiring more elaborate structural repairs, the project could extend to several days or even a week. Factors like weather conditions, stucco curing times, and the complexity of matching existing textures also influence the overall timeline. A contractor can provide a more precise timeline after an on-site assessment.
